records.body:

Leo

records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Blue Analytics
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Positive engagement: first project reached day 0, 1 invite sent, and Leo replied warmly saying things are going well with no complaints [email:75f8a2ef, slack:cc4361ec]. No tickets or blockers, 8 days left. But key milestone still unreached at day 6 and he's "still getting used to the layout," so momentum is modest.

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Glad to hear things are going well, and that the layout is starting to settle -- that's normal in the first week.

Since you've already got a project going and a teammate invited, the next thing most teams do is move their real work into it: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it's useful, teammates can also be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's still feeling unfamiliar and answer questions as they come up.

Best,
Nadia
